name: Lust IF
divergenceSummary: Subaru intervenes in the royal selection ceremony with overwhelming charisma and diplomatic brilliance, forming an unprecedented alliance uniting all five candidate camps and ascending the throne.
headline: Butterfly Dream: The Golden King
description: Subaru ascends the throne of Lugunica with a royal harem uniting all candidates, guiding the kingdom through an eccentric and peaceful era.

events.name: The Grand Royal Assembly Proclamation
events.description: Rather than clashing with the council, Subaru delivers an electrifying speech that dissolves factional conflict and proposes a collective sovereign council.

events.name: The Coronation of the Eccentric Sovereign
events.description: Subaru is officially crowned regent and spouse to the royal candidates in an opulent state banquet celebrated by commoners across all four borders.

events.name: The Golden Era of Lugunican Grand Feasts
events.description: With every foreign power pacified through diplomatic dinners and festival contracts, Lugunica enjoys a period of unprecedented harmony and joyous celebrations.
